title: Vanilama's Millstone
description: Grindstone and wheat what more do you need. this mod was made for a 1 hour mod creation challange by Just A Guy
body:
This is a mod made in 1 hour for a challange by [Just_A_Guy](https://modrinth.com/user/Just_A_Guy)

The mod adds a millstone block which is only accessible via the creative menu.
the millstone allows you to crush wheat into another new item Flour.
flour doesnt have a use either.

 this mod can be useful for making your own custom uses for this using mods like Kubejs.

 this mod is very barebones and doesnt feature many things but it can be useful as base
